source: Derived from a user-supplied Bing Webmaster Tools AI Page Stats export; raw authenticated export is intentionally not committed.
measurementBoundary: Citation counts are evidence of AI reuse, not traffic, ranking, conversion, revenue, or causal lift.

freshnessPolicy.rule: Citation demand signals may steer scheduling only while the dated snapshot is fresh. Missing, unparsable, future-dated, invalid, or expired signals fail closed to citation-neutral scheduling and never block unrelated scientific, safety, or governance work.

capacityPolicy.rule: Use citation-adjacent work as a strong ROI signal while preserving safety, scientific correctness, governance, blocker, and freshness gates. The target is a coordinator allocation goal, not permission to bypass the authoritative sprint/WIP system.

executionOrder: Protect and minimally perturb the two dominant winner pages.
Expand sleep and stress/anxiety clusters around proven cited answer patterns.
Audit overlapping sleep-supplement and duplicate-intent URLs before creating more adjacent pages.
Strengthen one canonical ADHD hub using the unusually broad 19-URL citation footprint.
Add careful downstream conversion paths to commercial-adjacent trust/review winners without weakening answer-first evidence.
Replicate proven answer/evidence/safety structures to adjacent eligible pages and measure citation spread over time.
guardrails: Never treat citation counts as revenue or traffic.
Never let citation priority bypass a hard scientific, safety, provenance, canonical-owner, review, accessibility, or release block.
Do not destructively rewrite high-citation passages without a migration/rollback reason and fresh measurement plan.
Keep at least 35 percent of discretionary discovery capacity for exploration so the system can discover new clusters.
Refresh this manifest from a fresh page-level export rather than carrying stale winner assumptions indefinitely.
